invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of Collections.singletonList(...).iterator(), which can never be null.
The iterator returned from Collections.singletonList(..) will always have at least one element, so hasNext() is true.
recordMap is passed as a method parameter and immediately used, so it must be non-null for correct execution.
If the iterator has a next element, next() will produce the singleton list, which is non-null.
Singleton list from createHandle.close() is likely non-empty; if next() is empty, there is no further next element.
